name: Oyster
summary: Oyster employs people in 120+ countries and generates a contract for each country's rules. The employer of record fee is $699 per employee per month, with setup, onboarding and terminations included, and a refundable deposit whose amount is not published.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Oyster says it supports 120+ countries and payroll in 120+ currencies.
Oyster says it carries liability insurance exceeding $8,000,000.
Oyster has a seat-based annual billing option at a reduced fee, and empty seats can be reused for new roles or backfills at no extra cost.
Oyster charges a currency conversion fee only when you pay in a currency other than the contract currency, and the pricing page does not give the amount.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: No minimum headcount. Annual seat pricing is available at a discount that is not published

hiddenCosts: A refundable deposit is required for each employer of record team member, and the amount is not published.
Paying in a currency other than the contract currency adds a conversion fee of an unpublished amount.
